description: This PHP source file manages the WAN network configuration page for a gateway device, including displaying current settings, enabling/disabling Ethernet or DOCSIS WAN modes, and handling user interactions with JavaScript.

methods.name: changeAutoWanMode
methods.description: Handles changing the WAN mode based on user selection, with confirmation prompts.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to save WAN network configuration.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to change the WAN mode.
